desc: Derive rigorously how one operation transforms four consecutive coordinates and reverses exactly three consecutive gaps.
Prove that reversals of three consecutive gaps generate arbitrary permutations separately on each gap-index parity class.
Minimize the coordinate sum by assigning each parity class's gap multiset to its coefficients using the rearrangement inequality.
Prove attainability of the optimized assignment and preservation of distinct coordinates.
Implement the \(O(N \log N)\) algorithm with exact integer arithmetic, and verify it on samples and edge cases.
